Federal taxable income = 45,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 29,250.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Line 9 = 45,000.00 - 10,476.00 = 34,524.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 0 x 250 = 0.00; line 10c 700.00. Line 11 taxable income = 34,524.00 - 700.00 = 33,824.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single) as numbers: 3.5% x 14,680.00 = 513.80 + 4.4% x 19,144.00 = 842.336; total 1,356.136, rounded once to 1,356.14. The Tax Table row 33,800 to 33,900 (PDF page 40) gives 1,357; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 1,356.14.
